tha-ap423:3.4: gañchiṁ paṭikuṭiṁ → gacchiṁ paṭikūṭī (bj) | paṭikūṭī → paṭikuṭiṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap423:4.1: tādimaggena → cārimaggena (bj, sya-all) | cārimaggena → tādimaggena (bj: machasaṁ)

tha-ap423:10.2: dussaniyesu → dosaniyesu (sya-all) | ca → dussaniyesu ca (bj: machasaṁ) | dussaniyesu → dosaniyesu (cck: sī. syā. ka.)

tha-ap423:11.1: ekanavutito → ekanavute ito (sya-all) | ito → ekanavutito (bj: machasaṁ) | Ekanavutito → ekanavute ito (cck: sī. syā.)
